nodes.source_text: Copper foil (99.999%, trace metals basis, 0.1 mm thick) was obtained from BeanTown Chemical (BTC) and dry polished with 3 M sandpaper (2500-grit). The polished copper foil was then sonicated in 1 M KOH for 10 min.

nodes.name: Electrolyte Purification
nodes.procedure: Purified 'Fe-free' KOH electrolytes (Fe < 10 ng/mL (ppb)) were prepared for electrochemical measurements following a previously reported protocol and confirmed to be Fe-free following established protocol.

unit_operations.name: Purification

nodes.source_text: Purified "Fe-free" KOH electrolytes (Fe < 10 ng/mL (ppb)) were prepared for electrochemical measurements following a previously reported protocol and confirmed to be Fe-free following established protocol

nodes.name: Electrochemical Roughening
nodes.procedure: The polished and sonicated Cu foil was electrochemically roughened in 0.1 M KCl by applying a series of potential steps: -0.5 V vs Hg/HgO for 15 s, + 0.3 V vs Hg/HgO for 4 s, and + 0.5 V vs Hg/HgO for 60 s. After each cycle, the cell was allowed to rest for 5 s. Following the roughening process, the foil was rinsed with water, dried with N2.

unit_operations.name: Rinsing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: the foil was rinsed with water

nodes.source_text: prior to the operando measurements, the polished and sonicated Cu foil was electrochemically roughened in 0.1 M KCl by applying a series of potential steps: -0.5 V vs Hg/HgO for 15 s, + 0.3 V vs Hg/HgO for 4 s, and + 0.5 V vs Hg/HgO for 60 s. ... Following the roughening process, the foil was rinsed with water, dried with N2, and prepared for Raman experiments.

nodes.name: Thin-Film Deposition
nodes.procedure: The Cu thin-film electrodes (100 nm) were deposited using a quartz crystal microbalance for growth control with e-beam evaporation on Ti-coated (5 nm) Si3N4 X-ray membranes (1 mm).

nodes.name: In situ Electrochemical Oxidation
nodes.procedure: The Cu electrode was subjected to anodic polarization under OER conditions. For ME-XAS experiments, the potential was modulated at 13 Hz between -0.4 and +1.8 V vs RHE to study the early formation of oxidized Cu species. Operando Raman was performed by sweeping from -500 mV vs Hg/HgO up to +1 V vs Hg/HgO in 0.1 M KOH.

nodes.description: Redox behavior and OER activity in purified Fe-free alkaline media (quiescent)
nodes.source_text: cyclic voltammetry (CV) conducted on Cu foil in 1.0 M Fe-free KOH electrolyte revealed... oxidation beyond Cu2+ to Cu3+ is indicated by the appearance of wave A at higher positive potentials (1.58 V vs RHE), along with the associated reduction wave B (1.51 V vs RHE). Results indicated that the charge corresponding to the reduction at wave B is approximately double that of the oxidative wave A

nodes.description: Effect of Fe impurities on OER activity
nodes.source_text: Trace amounts of Fe (2 μg/mL (ppm) to 5 μg/mL) in the solution measurably enhance the catalytic activity of the OER... observed trend where the OER overpotential decreases with increasing Fe concentration
